why_ai: Online instruments are software that AI-native assessment and AI-assisted cheating can both displace.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified across millions of candidates, but local validity is rarely checked.
why_digital: Candidates tested online, scores delivered into hiring systems, sold remotely.

why_ai: The ratios compute automatically, but law requires an independent auditor to sign and publish.
why_clarity: Selection-rate ratios by group are exact and checkable for every instrument.
why_digital: Score data in, published audit reports out, all digital.

why_ai: Item generation automates, but defining constructs that matter for a job needs I-O expertise.
why_clarity: Psychometric standards guide development, but validity against job performance takes months to establish.
why_digital: Job analyses and items developed on screens and delivered online.

why_ai: Passing scores and context into applicant tracking systems is pure integration engineering.
why_clarity: Each field either arrives in the ATS with its context or not.

why_ai: Delivery is solved software; accommodation paths are product work with some ADA obligations.
why_clarity: Timeouts, rendering failures and accommodation requests are measurable per session.

why_ai: Exposure detection and item rotation automate, though leakers and AI cheating are adversarial.
why_clarity: Item parameter drift reveals leakage statistically within a hiring season.
why_digital: Item banks, forums and response data monitored online.

why_ai: The method is known; access to client HR outcome data and defensible expertise are the barriers.
why_clarity: Validation method is codified, but performance outcomes take a year or more to accrue.
why_digital: HR outcome data joined to scores and analysed on screens.

why_ai: Presenting intervals and guardrails to hiring managers is product work AI explanations handle.
why_clarity: Correct interpretation is definable, but whether managers stop over-reading is hard to verify.
why_digital: Score reports and guidance delivered inside online hiring tools.

why_ai: Every candidate output is already computed; feedback delivery is a direct automation.
why_clarity: Each candidate either receives what was measured and why, or does not.
why_digital: Candidates assessed and informed entirely online.

why_ai: Judging misuse outside validated ranges needs accountable professional authority that AI checks cannot hold.
why_clarity: Professional standards are codified, but each misuse call is situational with slow consequences.
why_digital: Expertise delivered through documents and meetings with vendors and employers.

why_ai: Bias audits automate, but independent auditors and data-bound validation keep a human role.
why_clarity: Audit ratios are exact, while criterion validation waits on performance data.
why_digital: Score and outcome data analysed and reported online.
